profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Programming languages: Java, Ruby, Python, Javascripts and C/C++.
Cloud computing: Kubernetes, Google cloud, AWS.
Tech stack: Ruby on Rails, Javascript(AngluarJs, NodeJs and react), databases(Mysql, Postgres, NoSQL, BigQuery, Cassandra), docker
Hardware: Various memory systems such as SSD, flash and DRAM and basic circuit design.

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.locationName: San Francisco, California, United States · Hybrid

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
1. Developing cloud computing tools, such as microservice management and deployment, notification systems, artifacts managements with Java, Javascript and Python.
2. Developing OpenAPI management system for creating, verification and publishing schemas and use them in API interface verification with NodeJS, Java and Ruby.
3. Integrated Android SDK into CI/CD pipeline with docker.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer in Test
positions.description:
1. Built up test infrastructures (CI/CD) for functional, performance, compliance verifications with Google Cloud computing, Teamcity and Bitbuckets.
2. Developed mocking infrastructure with Ruby on Rails and open source project Wiremock.
3. Developed test suits for payment, notification and reporting systems.

positions.title: Staff Test Development Engineer
positions.description:
1. Developed production test solutions (software, hardware and infrastructure) for embedded products and SSD with Java and C++.
2. Developed data analysis and processing tools for production systems in Java and C/C++.
3. Created verification process, software of new product to meet client specifications and ensure smooth product launch.

positions.title: Design Validation Engineer
positions.description:
1. Developed test infrastructure(software/hardware) for SSD in automotive applications in C/C++(Linux).
2. Developed test programs on Nextest’s Magnum II platform for gaming device in C/C++(Visual Studio).
3. Developed test programs random test sequence pattern generator for memory products in Python.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
1. Maintained and expanded 3-tier data storage system(memory, hard drive and magnetic tape)for storing and distributing large volume of atomic research data in project dCache in Java.
2. Developed data visualization and analysis tools in Java and XSLT. 
3. Expanded existing databases interfaces using Java Spring dependency injection.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
1. Developed MRI data processing algorithm for researches in Matlab C/C++.
2. Developed medical ultrasonic data processing algorithms and visualization tools for research purposes in Matlab, C/C++.
